observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.dancers: mixed group of 11 young people (men and women)
observation.formation_and_space: line holding hands, moving sideways in a line
observation.footwork: side steps, crossing feet behind or in front, step-touch or grape-vine style footwork on the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: held hands in a line at waist/chest level, arms occasionally raised or lowered
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal torso movement, slight bouncing with steps
observation.levels_jumps_turns: standing level, low hops or steps, no floor work
observation.costume_and_props: matching white long-sleeve shirts and black trousers / pants; one dancer at the end holds a small instrument or prop (zurna/pipe/towel)
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details and subtle weight shifts due to camera resolution and distance

signature_moments.what: Sideways line travel with crossing foot steps while holding hands.
Brief pause where dancers bow forward slightly then clap overhead.
